simple.meaning: אׇזְנִי (ʼOznîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “Ozni , an Israelite; also an Oznite (collectively), his descendant.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אׇזְנִי (H244) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 26:16, with occurrences in Numbers.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אׇזְנִי (H244) before moving outward to related references.
